items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: He played with a player. You know, Chick Johnson.

ctx.x: Yeah. And you played with him much before in the 20s? Yeah, he had a spot job. Who was in the band? Was it a family band or was it a different guy or what? Do you remember?

Well, one time Benny Wilder played in the band then. Jesus. Benny Wilder's been playing for 99 years. He played in the band too. And Chink. Another guy. He's a non-union. He played with a player. You know, Chick Johnson. Chick Johnson, yeah.
